description: References both ways for an article (or point, part, or a whole act): the articles it cites, and the articles of other acts, of the same act and the energy regulator's (VERT) decisions that cite it. E.g. which rules and decisions apply an article of a law. Each item has its status and URL; read them with get_articles.

act.description: Act key, abbreviation, TAR code or name

article.description: Article or point number; omit for references to the act as a whole

part.description: Optional: one part ("2" or "d2"; a sub-point "p8.12")

name: related
